description: Creates a new intent in a Cognigy.AI flow for NLU recognition. MUTATING: This modifies the flow. Use dryRun=true (default) to validate first. After creating, use train_intents to train the NLU model.

condition.description: CognigyScript condition for additional matching constraints

description.description: Human-readable description of what this intent recognizes

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without creating. Set to false to actually create.

exampleSentences.description: Initial training sentences for the intent (created as example sentences, same as create_sentence)

flowId.description: The flow ID where the intent will be created

isDisabled.description: Whether the intent is disabled (won't match)

localeId.description: Locale ID for the example sentences. Defaults to the locale the intent is created in.

name: create_intent
